mapper.sql: c.cand_id,c.cand_nm,c.emp_type_cd,c.blng_clnt_id,c.telno,c.email_addr,c.prvc_agre_yn, c.prvc_agre_dt,c.prvc_agre_user_id,c.job_cd,c.sub_job_cd,c.grade_cd,c.home_area_cd, c.home_addr,c.hope_uprc,c.input_psbl_dt,c.cntc_stat_cd,c.last_cntc_dt,c.cand_src_cd, c.memo_cn,c.reg_dttm,c.mod_dttm,b.clnt_nm AS company_name, COALESCE(u.user_nm,c.prvc_agre_user_id) AS consent_user_name
LEFT JOIN TB_BS_CLNT b ON b.clnt_id=c.blng_clnt_id LEFT JOIN TB_SY_USER u ON u.user_id=c.prvc_agre_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_HR_CAND c WHERE c.cand_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM TB_HR_CAND c WHERE c.cand_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF c
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_HR_CAND(cand_id,cand_nm,emp_type_cd,blng_clnt_id,telno,email_addr, prvc_agre_yn,prvc_agre_dt,prvc_agre_user_id,job_cd,sub_job_cd,grade_cd,home_area_cd, home_addr,hope_uprc,input_psbl_dt,cntc_stat_cd,last_cntc_dt,cand_src_cd,memo_cn,reg_user_id,reg_dttm) VALUES(#{candidateId},#{input.name},#{input.employeeTypeCode},#{input.companyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{input.phone,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{input.email,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CASE WHEN #{input.privacyAgreement} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, CASE WHEN #{input.privacyAgreement} THEN #{today} ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{input.privacyAgreement} THEN 'admin' ELSE NULL END, #{input.primaryJobCode},#{input.secondaryJobCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{input.gradeCode}, #{input.homeAreaCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{input.homeAddress,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{input.desiredMonthlyRate},#{input.availableDate},'BEFORE',#{today},#{input.sourceCode}, #{input.memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'admin',clock_timestamp()) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT PK_TB_HR_CAND DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_HR_CAND SET cand_nm=#{input.name},emp_type_cd=#{input.employeeTypeCode}, blng_clnt_id=#{input.companyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},telno=#{input.phone,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, email_addr=#{input.email,jdbcType=VARCHAR},prvc_agre_yn=CASE WHEN #{input.privacyAgreement} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, prvc_agre_dt=CASE WHEN prvc_agre_dt IS NULL AND #{input.privacyAgreement} THEN #{today} ELSE prvc_agre_dt END, prvc_agre_user_id=CASE WHEN prvc_agre_dt IS NULL AND #{input.privacyAgreement} THEN 'admin' ELSE prvc_agre_user_id END, job_cd=#{input.primaryJobCode},sub_job_cd=#{input.secondaryJobCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},grade_cd=#{input.gradeCode}, home_area_cd=#{input.homeAreaCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},home_addr=#{input.homeAddress,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, hope_uprc=#{input.desiredMonthlyRate},input_psbl_dt=#{input.availableDate},cand_src_cd=#{input.sourceCode}, memo_cn=#{input.memo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},mod_user_id='admin', mod_dttm=GREATEST(clock_timestamp(),mod_dttm+INTERVAL '1 microsecond') WHERE cand_id=#{candidateId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.skill_nm FROM TB_HR_CAND_SKILL s WHERE s.cand_id=#{id} ORDER BY s.sort_ord,s.skill_nm
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_HR_CAND SET cntc_stat_cd=#{status},last_cntc_dt=#{today},mod_user_id='admin', mod_dttm=GREATEST(clock_timestamp(),mod_dttm+INTERVAL '1 microsecond') WHERE cand_id=#{candidateId}
mapper.select: SELECT h.cntc_stat_cd,h.cntc_memo,h.reg_dttm,h.reg_user_id FROM TB_HR_CAND_CNTC h WHERE h.cand_id=#{id} ORDER BY h.reg_dttm DESC,h.cntc_sn DESC
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TB_BS_CLNT b WHERE b.clnt_id=#{id} AND b.use_yn='Y' AND b.clnt_type_cd IN ('VNDR','BOTH'))
SELECT a.area_cd,concat_ws(' ',a.sido_nm,a.sgg_nm,a.emd_nm) AS address FROM TB_SY_ADM_AREA a WHERE a.area_cd=#{code} AND a.use_yn='Y'

SELECT o.opp_id,n.need_sn,o.opp_nm,o.win_prbl_rt,n.job_cd,n.grade_cd,n.bgn_ym,n.prd_mcnt,n.expct_uprc FROM TB_SL_OPP o JOIN TB_SL_OPP_NEED n ON n.opp_id=o.opp_id WHERE o.opp_stat_cd='ING' AND n.job_cd=#{jobCode} AND n.prd_mcnt > 0 AND n.need_cnt > 0 AND n.expct_uprc > 0 ORDER BY o.opp_id,n.need_sn
SELECT c.code_val FROM TB_SY_CODE c WHERE c.code_grp_id='ALWNC' AND c.code=#{code} AND c.use_yn='Y' AND c.del_yn='N'
